description:
Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 (with Ceramides) serum is an updated version of our original formulation. This second-generation formulation combines ingredients for enhanced hydration, barrier support, and smoother skin. The addition of ceramides provides barrier support while retaining multi-depth hydration benefits.

Key Features

Advanced, multi-layer hydration: This hyaluronic acid serum features low-, medium-, and high-molecular-weight hyaluronic acid, a hyaluronic acid crosspolymer, and hydrolyzed hyaluronic acid. These 5 types of hyaluronic acid work together to hydrate the surface of the skin at multiple levels, re-plumping dry, dehydrated areas and improving suppleness.

Barrier support with ceramides: Ceramides, a natural lipid found in the skin, lock in water while strengthening the skin’s moisture barrier. This formulation includes ceramides to ensure long-term hydration and help protect the skin from environmental stressors.

Pro-vitamin B5 (panthenol): Supports the production of ceramides and fatty acids to further support the skin barrier. Panthenol also enhances the skin’s ability to retain moisture.

Lightweight, non-tacky texture: This second-generation hyaluronic acid serum absorbs quickly and dries to a non-tacky finish, making it suitable for layering with other skincare products.

name: The Ordinary Natural Moisturizing Factors + Hyaluronic Acid, Lightweight Hydrator for Skin Barrier Support & Hydration, Travel Size
description:
Natural Moisturizing Factors + HA is an effective moisturizer designed to mimic the composition of your skin’s natural hydration system. This moisturizer provides both immediate and lasting effects by replenishing lost moisture and fortifying the skin barrier over time. The addition of hyaluronic acid enhances the product’s ability to retain moisture in the skin, offering effective skin hydration throughout the day, while the inclusion of ceramides and phospholipids ensures your skin remains supple and resilient against environmental stressors.

This formulation also features a Tasmanian pepperberry derivative, a plant extract that helps soothe the skin and reduce irritation commonly associated with exfoliation, making it suitable for frequent use. The presence of this natural ingredient may cause seasonal colour variation in the formula. With a carefully calibrated pH of approximately 3.6, the toner has an optimal balance between salt and acidity.

This multi-functional toner is not only effective on the face, but can also be applied to the scalp to help rebalance, hydrate, and reduce dryness. This formulation should not be used on sensitive, peeling, or compromised skin. description:

Mixing Guide: In its truest form, Niacinamide is readily water-soluble and dissolves in water-based products, such as serums and creams, with ease. The Ordinary’s 100% Niacinamide Powder can be mixed into any non-conflicting, water-based treatment, provided that the pH of the base is between 5.0 and 7.0. This pH of this formula is approximately 3.8. Lactic Acid has a pKa of 3.8 and pKa is the most important aspect to consider in formulating with acids. pKa implies acid availability. When pKa is close to pH, there is an optimal balance between salt and acidity, optimizing the delivery of the acid form to ensure it provides an effective exfoliation that can be used daily.
